summary: Review layer inventory for pi-scholar. review-layer.ts is a dual-purpose module: the mode-agnostic engine (reviewOne, runReviewPass, aggregateReviews, receipts, evidence readers, concurrency) plus mode-specific packet planners (planReviewAssignments for Learn, planExamReviewPackets for Exam, planTutorExplanationPacket for Tutor, reviewTargetQuestion for Learn+Tutor questions). learn-review.ts is the de-facto facade (the only importer of review-layer.ts, used by tool-controller.ts:3) and duplicates currentReviewSnapshots/uniqueBatches; it also holds an unused alias `const instructions = REVIEW_INSTRUCTIONS` (learn-review.ts:64). All mode branching lives OUTSIDE the review layer: review-layer.ts, review-runtime.ts and learn-review.ts contain zero mode-string conditionals; they discriminate structurally (`"learnQuality" in target`, review-layer.ts:588). Mode strings appear only in tool-controller.ts (pass triggers/commits) and index.ts (quiz prehook). Three different approval gates exist: Learn uses learnReviewIssues (lesson.ts:266) with contentHash+sourceHash+roles; Tutor and Exam use ad-hoc, hash-free response-coverage checks (tool-controller.ts:696-702, 861-867).

files.description: Shared review engine + all three packet planners. Exports reviewOne:156, runReviewPass:398, aggregateReviews:113, REVIEW_INSTRUCTIONS:79, REVIEW_CONCURRENCY:76, role-based crop/view/read scoping (199-224).

Facade over review-layer: re-export block 19-35/38-51, planReviewAssignments:97 (Learn crew), reviewCheckpoint:169, reviewLearnDraft:180 (Learn pass w/ per-role reuse), reviewLearnQuestion:217 (test-only wrapper).

All review trigger/commit anchors and the only mode-string branching: reviewQuestion:215-228, tutor pass:694-762, learn pass:763-819, exam pass:859-898, checkpoint persistence:195-213, withReview:160-193.
learnReviewHash:250, learnReviewIssues:266 (Learn-only approval gate: hash match + per-role latest receipt + responses), commitLesson:348, lessonReady:355.
Mode-agnostic receipt schema: REVIEW_ROLES:147, ReviewReceipt:161, isReviewReceipt:286, reviewGateIssues:310, computeFindingKey:188, parseReviewerVerdict:253.

architecture: Three layers. (1) review-runtime.ts = transport: runReviewer (bounded single-agent loop, isolated context, scoped readers, limits, cancellation) — fully mode-agnostic, imports only REVIEW_ROLES/parseReviewerVerdict from learn-quality. (2) review-layer.ts = orchestration + planning: generic reviewOne (one role, one packet) and runReviewPass (parallel workers, per-packet cache, retry-once, aggregate) sit beside three mode-specific planners; `prepared:true` switches reviewOne from a tool loop (maxTurns 24) to pre-loaded evidence (maxTurns 2). (3) Callers: learn-review.ts (Learn crew planning + per-role reuse + checkpoints) and tool-controller.ts (pass triggers, once-latches, receipt persistence, per-mode approval gates). Receipts are one schema for all modes, but only Learn stores them in a hash-gated structure with `batches`; Tutor/Exam store a bare {version,receipts,responses} and gate on unresolved blocking findings only.
